The company shows solid operating performance (EBIT margin ~17% on revenue) and comfortable near-term liquidity (current ratio ~2.2), which supports repayment capacity. However, leverage is relatively high (total liabilities ~3,366M vs. assets ~4,997M) and retained earnings are materially negative (-1,086M), indicating weaker long-run capital resilience. Overall this balances to a lower investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB-
